description.value: Breka Bakery & Café is a local Vancouver family business born in 2006 from a well-established German bakery at Fraser and 49th in the Sunset neighbourhood, now operating 8 locations across the city. Regularly voted among Vancouver's best bakeries and cafés, it built its reputation on quality baked goods, sandwiches, soups, and hot beverages spanning a wide range of dietary preferences. The original Fraser Street flagship remains a neighbourhood institution and a convenient resupply stop for cyclists travelling through the Sunset and Oakridge corridors.

Vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options are confirmed by dedicated menu sections on the /our-selection page, corroborated by OSM tag diet:vegetarian=yes. Takeout is confirmed via the online ordering app, Grab & Go menu category, and Uber Eats partnership; however, bike parking, washrooms, water refill, and Wi-Fi are not mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established Vancouver bakery and café with substantial food options including vegan and GF items, takeout, and Grab & Go — a clear benefit to touring cyclists resupplying on the Fraser Street corridor.
